sub_graphs.title: Electra Fork: Beacon State Upgrade Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition when the beacon chain upgrades from Deneb to Electra at the designated fork epoch

nodes.label: Beacon State at Deneb
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running Deneb; current epoch has not yet reached ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Fork Epoch Boundary Reached
nodes.description: The system has reached the first slot of ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, triggering the upgrade

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_electra
nodes.description: Transforms the pre-Deneb beacon state into an Electra beacon state, copying all existing fields and initializing new Electra-specific fields

nodes.label: Compute Earliest Exit Epoch
nodes.description: Scans all validators to find the maximum exit epoch and computes earliest_exit_epoch for proper exit sequencing

nodes.label: Compute Exit Balance to Consume
nodes.description: Calculates the activation exit churn limit for the new epoch to initialize exit_balance_to_consume

nodes.label: Queue Pending Deposits for Inactive Validators
nodes.description: Converts validators not yet active into pending deposit entries, zeroing their balances and adding them to pending_deposits queue

nodes.label: Queue Excess Active Balance
nodes.description: For validators with compounding withdrawal credentials, queues any excess balance above MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_ELECTRA as pending deposits

nodes.label: Beacon State at Electra
nodes.description: The beacon state has been fully upgraded to Electra with all new fields initialized

edges.label: Determine earliest exit epoch from validator set
Calculate churn limits for exit balance
Process inactive validators into pending deposits

sub_graphs.title: Electra Fork: Fork Version Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of fork version metadata during the Electra upgrade to ensure chain continuity

nodes.label: Previous Fork Metadata Read
nodes.description: The system reads the current fork version and epoch from the pre-upgrade state

nodes.label: Validate Fork Version Update
nodes.description: Ensures previous_version is set to old current_version, current_version is set to ELECTRA_FORK_VERSION, and epoch is set to ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Fork Version Updated
nodes.description: Fork metadata correctly reflects the Electra upgrade with proper version chaining

nodes.label: Compute New Fork Digest
nodes.description: Derives the new fork digest from ELECTRA_FORK_VERSION and genesis validators root for network identification

nodes.label: Electra Fork Digest Active
nodes.description: Network participants use the new fork digest for message signing and topic subscriptions

edges.label: New fork digest propagated to network layer

sub_graphs.title: Electra Fork: Deposit Queue Migration
sub_graphs.description: Models how existing pending validators are migrated into the new Electra deposit queue system during the fork

nodes.label: Validators Pending Activation (Pre-Fork)
nodes.description: Validators exist in the validator set with activation_epoch == FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH, meaning they have not yet been activated

nodes.label: Identify Inactive Validators
nodes.description: Scan validator set to find all validators with activation_epoch == FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH and effective_balance > 0

nodes.label: Zero Validator Effective Balance
nodes.description: Set effective_balance to 0 and move actual balance to pending_deposits entry

nodes.label: Create Pending Deposit Entry
nodes.description: Create a PendingDeposit record with the validator pubkey, withdrawal credentials, amount, and slot

nodes.label: Deposit Queued in Electra System
nodes.description: The validator's deposit is now tracked in the pending_deposits queue for orderly processing under Electra rules

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clearly define the ordering of pending deposit entries when multiple validators are migrated simultaneously during the upgrade.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume deposits are ordered by validator index in ascending order, as this is the natural iteration order. This needs verification against the implementation.

ambiguities.text: The term 'compounding withdrawal credentials' is referenced without a full definition of which credential prefixes qualify.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume compounding credentials refer to the 0x02 prefix type introduced in EIP-7251. This needs cross-reference verification.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes in the network will reach ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH at approximately the same time and apply the upgrade atomically.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network split if some nodes upgrade at different epochs, leading to competing chain forks with incompatible state formats.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator set state is consistent and complete at the fork boundary, with no partially-applied state transitions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Deposit migration could produce incorrect pending_deposits entries if validator state is inconsistent, leading to balance loss or duplication.

implicit_assumptions.description: The exit churn limits computed during fork upgrade are sufficient to prevent mass exit attacks in the first Electra epoch.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could pre-position validators to exploit the churn calculation window during fork transition.
